key_insight: Stabilized isogeometric topology optimization enables minimum-compliance design on complex trimmed geometries without sensitivity analysis.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports structural optimization with complex boundaries and non-design regions while addressing numerical instability caused by trimming.
method: Evolve a generalized fourth-order Cahn–Hilliard model toward steady-state optimized structures.
Use Nitsche’s formulation with minimal stabilization to impose Dirichlet conditions and control trimming-induced instability.
Extend the immersed boundary-conformal method to handle complex non-design regions and material–void interfaces.
evidence_signal: A three-dimensional biharmonic problem and several two-dimensional topology optimization examples demonstrate effectiveness, stability, and geometric flexibility.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish performance for full three-dimensional topology optimization or quantify computational cost.
paper_title: Stabilized Isogeometric Topology Optimization on Trimmed Geometries
